reading: Sample 2 is the strong one. The reference gradient for block 47's largest-mass tensor -- 73.53 % of that block's gradient mass -- is right to 3.990e-03, and our device gradient for THAT SAME TENSOR is 1.0575 out: 265x the reference's own validation error, and still 68x under the best arm measured. Sample 1 says the same for the diffusion module, which holds 89.2 % of the model's gradient mass, at 2.417e-07. D22/D23 had already controlled the reference's REVISION; these two samples independently confirm its NUMERICAL correctness at both failure sites.
